instruction: Set the background of all slides to cyan using the Master View.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying a cyan background (RGB [0, 255, 255]) to all slides using Master View settings. The evaluator uses the existing evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance metric to calculate color distance from the target cyan. Original background is white [255, 255, 255]. Verified that the metric returns a score based on RGB distance normalized by maximum possible distance.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to set cyan background on all slides using Master View
Getter (vm_file) extracts the correct state - the modified PPTX file containing background color changes
Metric (evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance) checks the right property - slide background fill colors via both direct fills and master slide fills (fill.type==1 and fill.type==5)
Expected values are semantically correct - target RGB [0,255,255] is exact cyan, original RGB [255,255,255] is white matching the original presentation
Logic correctly handles Master View modifications by checking master slide backgrounds (fill.type==5)
Complete coverage - metric iterates through all slides and checks each background, ensuring full verification
Postconfig appropriately saves the file (Ctrl+S) to ensure PPTX is written to disk before getter fetches it
Scoring logic is sound - returns continuous score 0.0-1.0 based on RGB distance, with 1.0 for perfect cyan match and lower scores for other colors
No parameter handling errors - metric correctly accesses rules['rgb'] and rules['original_rgb'] directly
